meta.scope: Three independently timed, resolving US macroeconomic announcements in March 2026.
meta.interpretation: After these specific releases, the contract answer is publicly determined. Distance to its independently verified 0-or-1 answer measures residual price error, not calibration of uncertain future events. This narrow case audit does not estimate a general news-processing delay.
meta.priceMethod: One YES token per binary contract; active five-minute close at the exact target timestamp. No interpolation. A bar ending at release time contains pre-release trades; the first fully post-release bar ends five minutes later. Actual trade time inside a bar is unknown.
meta.matching: Matched 5-, 15- and 60-minute curves keep the same contracts at every point. Complete cases select contracts with continued observed trading and need not represent all 31 eligible contracts. The separate availability table changes its denominator and must not be read as a fixed-cohort time series.
meta.uncertainty: Only three independent announcements. No confidence intervals or significance claims are reported. Multiple binary buckets and two statistics in one release are not independent news events.
meta.economicLimit: The 0-or-1 benchmark ignores fees, settlement delay, dispute/platform risk and financing costs. Small residual distances from the payout are not automatically informational mistakes.
meta.timingLimit: Arrival times are observed bar-end bounds, not second-level latency. Two-bar confirmation requires adjacent observed closes and occurs five minutes after the first qualifying close. Sustained-through-60 requires at least two closes and every remaining five-minute bar; missing trades never count as stability. Trading can stop because the answer is known: absent bars are unobserved, not failures or slow reactions.
meta.sourceCredit: Akey, Grégoire, Harvie and Martineau (2026), Polymarket Users Dataset. CC BY 4.0.
meta.clockRepair: All 31 recorded scheduled expirations precede the verified release. This audit therefore uses observed raw bars until the recorded actual close, rather than the main study’s earlier-expiry-or-close proxy. It never extends prices after the actual close or fills missing observations.
